roast: {{author}} wrote this {{age}} and called the commit "{{commitMsg}}". It is still here. It has outlived two roadmaps.
Committed at {{hour}} on a {{weekday}}. That is not a code review problem, that is a wellness check.
{{author}}, you have {{dirtyCount}} uncommitted files in your working tree right now. Glass houses.
The charge is {{charge}}. The defence is "{{commitMsg}}". The court is not moved.
{{file}}, line {{line}}. {{author}}. Untouched since {{date}}, because nobody dares.
This arrived on a branch called {{branch}}. Everything about it was preventable.
{{author}} looked at {{charge}} and thought: yes, this is the one I put my name on.
Somewhere out there is a reviewer who approved this. They know what they did.
{{author}} wrote "{{commitMsg}}" {{age}} and walked away like nothing had happened.
The charge is {{charge}}. Shipped {{date}}. Still shipping. Sleep well.
I ran git blame expecting a stranger. It was {{author}}. It is always {{author}}.
The commit message says "{{commitMsg}}". The code says otherwise.
{{author}} had an entire programming language available and chose {{charge}}.
Line {{line}} of {{file}} has been sitting there since {{date}} and it has never once paid rent.
One line, {{charge}}, by {{author}}, at {{hour}}. Three facts, one conclusion.
apology: I, {{author}}, wrote this on {{date}}. I told myself it was temporary. That was {{age}}. I have learned nothing.
Forgive me. The commit message said "{{commitMsg}}". I was lying to us both.
It was {{hour}} on a {{weekday}}. I was not myself. I have never been myself.
I did that. {{charge}}, on purpose, with my own hands.
In my defence the branch was called {{branch}}. In my defence, that is not a defence.
I have {{dirtyCount}} uncommitted files and the audacity to still be standing here.
This has been in {{file}} since {{date}}. Every day I did not fix it was a decision.
I wrote "{{commitMsg}}" and I meant it at the time. That is the worst part.
Past me left this for present me. Present me is leaving it for future me. We are a team.
That is {{charge}}. I would apologise properly but I am about to do it again.
This one is mine. Line {{line}}. No notes, no excuses, no plans to fix it either.
I wrote this {{age}} and have walked past it every day since, whistling.
